title: Conditional Flow Models for Offline Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline maximum entropy reinforcement learning seeks to estimate the optimal soft action-value function \(Q^*\) from a fixed dataset without further interaction with the environment. Although \(Q^*\) is characterized by the soft optimal Bellman equation, the corresponding Bellman operator cannot be evaluated directly because both the reward distribution and the transition kernel are unknown. Consequently, estimating \(Q^*\) requires the joint treatment of environment modeling and value function learning. We propose a framework that addresses these tasks separately. Conditional diffusion models based on probability flow ODEs estimate the conditional reward distribution and transition kernel. The resulting distributional estimators define a data driven approximation of the soft optimal Bellman operator, whose empirical Bellman residual is minimized over a class of deep neural networks to estimate \(Q^*\). translated_title: 离线最大熵强化学习的条件流模型
translated_abstract: 离线最大熵强化学习旨在从固定数据集中估计最优软动作价值函数 Q*，而无需与环境进行进一步的交互。尽管 Q* 由软最优贝尔曼方程刻画，但由于奖励分布和转移核均未知，相应的贝尔曼算子无法直接计算。因此，估计 Q* 需要同时对环境建模和价值函数学习进行联合处理。我们提出了一个将这两项任务分开处理的框架。基于概率流常微分方程（ODE）的条件扩散模型用于估计条件奖励分布和转移核。由此得到的分布估计器定义了软最优贝尔曼算子的数据驱动近似，通过在一类深度神经网络中最小化经验贝尔曼残差来估计 Q*。我们建立了非渐近的理论保证……
tldr: 该论文提出一个分离式框架，利用基于概率流ODE的条件扩散模型分别估计奖励分布和转移核，从而构建软最优贝尔曼算子的数据驱动近似来估计最优软动作价值函数，并提供了非渐近理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework using conditional diffusion models based on probability flow ODEs to separately estimate the reward distribution and transition kernel, enabling a data-driven approximation of the soft optimal Bellman operator to estimate Q* with nonasymptotic guarantees.
